panels.title: Component recognition and labeling
panels.caption: Manual-derived component terms are grounded to visible regions of the A1 mini and AMS Lite.
panels.claim: Manual component semantics can be grounded to visible physical components on the tested device.

panels.title: Guided spool placement on the AMS Lite holder
panels.caption: A visible empty spindle surface is segmented while a reviewed virtual spool and insertion arrow are anchored to the same physical target.
panels.claim: The tested system converts a manual-derived spool-placement step into viewpoint-adaptive visible-surface segmentation and world-anchored guidance.

panels.title: Spatial guidance for filament insertion
panels.caption: The target feeder module is outlined and a world-anchored arrow communicates the insertion direction without fabricating an occluded inlet hole.
panels.claim: The tested system grounds an insertion instruction to the visible feeder module and PTFE path on the selected slot.

panels.title: Verification of successful filament loading
panels.caption: Before and after evidence is evaluated with necessary state predicates; progression is enabled only when the deterministic safety gate passes.
panels.claim: The tested system verifies visible before/after loading evidence rather than treating spool placement alone as task completion.

panels.title: Pre-print build plate inspection
panels.caption: Visible plate presence, alignment, surface clearance, and residue predicates are reported with evidence regions.
panels.claim: The tested system inspects visible build-plate installation and surface conditions without inferring temperature or print readiness.

panels.title: Closed-loop detection and corrective guidance for setup errors
panels.caption: An incorrect visible path is marked as error evidence, progression remains blocked, and guidance is redirected to the correct feeder module.
panels.claim: For the tested safe setup error, the system refuses progression and provides grounded corrective guidance until re-verification succeeds.
